_note: Platform application catalog for the Tenant Control Plane. The x1/x2/xweb entries are the member apps the Hub deep-links (src/xhub/config/member-apps.ts); the remaining entries mirror the handoff data/application-catalog.json (platform systems). ownerSystem/capabilities are grounded in those sources — no ERP system is fabricated. provisioningMode MOCK means the mock app adapter simulates account creation (no real account).

applications.name: Meyland
applications.notes: ERP bất động sản — web ERP (rổ hàng) và app khách hàng. Staff dùng XHub identity.

applications.name: X2-BMS
applications.notes: SaaS vận hành chung cư. Staff dùng XHub identity; resident có thể là domain riêng.

applications.name: X Web Platform
applications.notes: Multi-site content — Next.js + Payload CMS. App-local role mapping.

applications.name: X.Space / Mattermost
applications.notes: REST/SCIM-like adapter; Mattermost giữ app-local user state.
